# kkp_cluster (Data Source)

Looks up a cluster by ID or by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kkp_cluster" "staging" {
  name = "staging"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Must match exactly one cluster of the project.
- `project_id` (String) Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `available_upgrades` (List of String) Versions the control plane can be upgraded to.
- `cloud_provider` (String)
- `datacenter` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether all control plane components are healthy.
- `url` (String)
- `version` (String)
